facts.fact: The Registration Division of Seychelles publishes an online business registration form on registry.gov.sc capturing entity name, registration type, business type, addresses, partners or owners, supporting documents, tax-related information and share capital.

note: Speaks of a transition to digital services at the Registrar General's office but does not say business registration is online or being digitised.
Mentions business registration only as a bidder eligibility condition.

systems.owner: Ministry of Investment, Entrepreneurship and Industry

note: The tender is for an investment portal that interfaces with the Registration Division; it does not say it registers firms or digitises a business register.

facts.fact: The National Assembly approved R5.5 million in the 2026 Ministry of Industry and Enterprise budget for an investment portal to serve as a one-stop shop for investment and business registration, with completion expected by the third quarter of 2026.

systems.system: Registrar of Companies electronic filing (proposed section 10A)

note: A bill enabling regulations for electronic filing is an enabling provision, not a register procured, records digitised or online registration in service.
An enabling bill for electronic filing is not a register under way or in service.
Only counts of new registrations; no aspect holds a count.
